name: Eneva S.A.
summary: Eneva S.A., an integrated energy company, engages in the exploration, production, and commercialization of natural gas and liquids in Brazil. The company generates electricity through natural gas, steam, coal, and solar energy. It also supplies natural gas solutions to the on-grid and off-grid market for thermal power plants, pipeline operators, and industrial clients; including transportation, LNG regasification, and floating storage. The company was formerly known as MPX Energia S.A. and changed its name to Eneva S.A. in October 2013. Eneva S.A. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro, Brazil.
